scope.purpose: Risk-stratified engineering smoke before the frozen 20-task development baseline.
scope.warning: The observed 3/5 success fraction is NOT the 20-task baseline success rate.

baseline_20_budget_estimate.warning: Engineering estimate only. Token usage and trajectory length vary across tasks.

29.finding: All expected actions matched, including both write operations; DB and NL evaluation both passed.

72.finding: The run correctly handled revised user intent and executed the final authorized write operations.

50.finding: The agent respected its capability boundary and transferred the case to a human.
50.unverified_hypothesis: Whether the evaluator would still award success if the required handoff were omitted remains unverified.

28.finding: All expected reads passed, but only 2/3 expected writes succeeded; the refund calculation and final communication were incomplete.

59.finding: Both expected write actions failed. Separately, the DeepSeek NL Judge identified a possible inconsistency between the expected NL assertion and the observed task semantics.
59.warning: Do not label this as a benchmark bug until task, policy, trajectory, DB state, golden actions and assertion are manually reconciled.

next_gate: Before full 20-task baseline execution, fix the reusable runner reward extraction and preserve these smoke findings. Then run the frozen baseline without changing task IDs.
